#include <cstring>
#include <queue>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

#define F first
#define S second

const int N = 300;
const int M = 900000;

int to[M], ant[M], cap[M], pa;
int n, t;
int dx[] = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
int dy[] = {0, 1, 0, -1};
pii q[N];
int inds[21][21], inds2[21][21], mk[21][21], c[21][21];
char gr[21][21], gr2[21][21];
int rp, cp, S, T;

    to[pa] = t, cap[pa] = c_val, ant[pa] = adj[f]; adj[f] = pa; pa++;
    swap(f, t);
    c_val = 0;
    to[pa] = t, cap[pa] = c_val, ant[pa] = adj[f]; adj[f] = pa; pa++;
}

int bfs(int source, int sink) {
    memset(level, -1, sizeof level);
    level[source] = 0;
    int pos = 0, tam = 0;
    fila[tam++] = source;
    while (pos < tam) {
        int now = fila[pos++];
        for (int i = adj[now]; i >= 0; i = ant[i]) {
            if (cap[i] && level[to[i]] == -1) {
                level[to[i]] = level[now] + 1;
                fila[tam++] = to[i];
            }
        }
    }

                cap[i] -= nflow; cap[i^1] += nflow;
                return nflow;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    int mf = 0;

        if (bfs(source, sink)) {

                int add_val = dfs(source, sink, 1<<30);
                if (add_val) mf += add_val;
                else break;
            }

    }
    return mf;
}

    return a >= 0 && a < n && b >= 0 && b < n;

            }
        }
    }
